hint.zh-CN: 建议在 bot 账号下创建 Fine-grained PAT（Repository access 选 All repositories）。加密保存，模型和 shell 都拿不到。
hint.en: Create a fine-grained PAT under the bot account (Repository access: All repositories). Stored encrypted; neither the model nor the shell can read it.

hint.zh-CN: 注入 shell 和子代理的 GIT_AUTHOR_NAME / GIT_COMMITTER_NAME；留空则使用 token 账号的登录名。
hint.en: GIT_AUTHOR_NAME / GIT_COMMITTER_NAME passed to the shell and subagents; leave empty to use the token account's login.

hint.zh-CN: 留空则使用 token 账号的 noreply 邮箱（<id>+<login>@users.noreply.github.com）。
hint.en: Leave empty to use the token account's noreply email (<id>+<login>@users.noreply.github.com).

description.zh-CN: 署名 ShiritaiBot 为共同作者

hint.zh-CN: 开启后，提交信息带上 Co-authored-by: ShiritaiBot <shiritaibot@shiritaibot.dev>：主 Agent shell 里的 git commit 和 pr_merge 自动追加；新启动的子代理会在提示词中被要求加上（任务明确不提交时忽略）。
hint.en: When on, commit messages get Co-authored-by: ShiritaiBot <shiritaibot@shiritaibot.dev>: git commit in the main Agent's shell and pr_merge add it automatically, and newly started subagents are asked in their prompt to add it (ignored when the task says not to commit).

description.zh-CN: 允许操作的账号或组织

hint.zh-CN: 每行一个；只能操作这些账号名下的仓库。留空则只允许 token 账号本身。
hint.en: One per line; only repositories owned by these accounts can be changed. Leave empty to allow only the token account itself.

hint.zh-CN: 访问 GitHub API 和 git 推送时使用的代理，如 http://127.0.0.1:7890 或 socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080。留空则 API 请求沿用 HTTP(S)_PROXY 环境变量，git 推送直连。
hint.en: Proxy for the GitHub API and git pushes, such as http://127.0.0.1:7890 or socks5h://127.0.0.1:1080. Leave empty: API requests use the HTTP(S)_PROXY environment variables and git pushes connect directly.
